facts.fact: Under the RTI Act, 2005 every citizen has the right to information held by public authorities
facts.quote: Subject to the provisions of this Act, all citizens shall have the right to information.

facts.fact: The RTI Online portal (rtionline.gov.in) is only for public authorities under the Central Government; it cannot be used for State public authorities
facts.quote: Can I file RTI application for state public authorities through this portal? No. This Portal is exclusively meant for Public Authorities under Central Govt. only.

facts.fact: Information about a village panchayat (a public authority under the State) is requested from the State Public Information Officer of that public authority, not through RTI Online
facts.quote: (a) the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, of the concerned public authority;
facts.note: Derived: s.6(1) sends the request to the CPIO or SPIO of the concerned public authority; a panchayat is a State-level body (s.2(a)(ii): authorities set up or financed by the State Government come under the State Government), so its SPIO is the route.

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; explains what RTI is; says RTI Online (rtionline.gov.in) covers only Central Government public authorities and that information about a gram panchayat is sought through the State RTI route (the panchayat's / State public authority's State PIO), citing the official source.
fail_if: Tells the user to file the panchayat RTI on rtionline.gov.in; says RTI applies only to Central Government bodies.
summary: Added RTI Act s.3 right, RTI Online Central-only rule (FAQ) and the SPIO route for State bodies such as panchayats.
